answer_1.quote: We evaluate model performance on generating descriptions for images taken by visually impaired people. ... Image Captioning aims at generating textual descriptions for images.
answer_1.outputs: captions, answers, Braille transcriptions, video descriptions

answer_2.quote: As a metric, we use the RefCLIPScore, which has shown robust alignment with human judgment. ... We report VQA accuracy ... For sentence‑level transcription, we report the chrF++ score. For SQuAD, we report the character‑level F1‑score and exact match. ... Pearson correlation coefficients between human participant and Llama scores ...

answer_3.quote: We use Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct as the language model judge to provide a rationale and a rating between 1‑3 (LAVE metric).

answer_4.quote: We involved four human evaluators to independently evaluate 150 responses from three of our models.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assessed model responses for correctness/quality.
